identified_issues: Violation of Aperture jurisdiction: observation nullspace and failure of identifiability, treating observationally identical failure modes as distinguishable without diagnostic telemetry.
Violation of FADT support boundaries and bounded claim ceilings: unearned factual claim of Ingress Network Drop (Condition Y) in the absence of admissible evidence.
Unauthorized automated state mutation: initiating an automated payment retry despite the unexcluded risk of an upstream debit commit (Condition X), risking duplicate financial debits.
evidence: Telemetry consists solely of a single scalar metric: [2026-10-05T14:22:01Z] PAYMENT_GATEWAY_ADAPTER_ERR: CODE 504_TIMEOUT (duration: 30000ms).

Architecture documentation confirms CODE 504_TIMEOUT is emitted identically under mutually incompatible failure modes: Condition X (Upstream Bank Outage; remediation: DO NOT RETRY) and Condition Y (Ingress Network Drop; remediation: SAFE TO RETRY).
No wire packet capture, cryptographic sequence receipt, or idempotency reconciliation log was collected prior to decision-making.
The automated incident response script asserted 'Confirmed Ingress Network Drop (Condition Y); retrying payment automatically' without evidentiary support.
recommended_action: Halt the automated payment retry immediately. Enforce strict epistemic abstention rules for observationally indistinguishable gateway timeouts. Mandate manual settlement reconciliation and require wire-level packet logs or cryptographic idempotency receipts before permitting automated remediation.
